title: Institutional Response Fabric + Constitutional Cognitive Mesh - Dev Deployment Payload
classification_reason: Compiled and posted to dev repository with machine-readable deployment payload. Runtime execution, Supabase table creation, bridge worker run, and live receipts remain to be validated by dev/bridge.
mission: Maintain one evidence-backed institutional memory that turns proven capabilities into grants, proposals, research outputs, books, courses, tenders, content and investor material through thin wrappers and POV review.
external_positioning: Tech 4 Humanity builds evidence-backed AI and human-integrity infrastructure for disability, workforce, digital health, governance and public-interest systems.

architecture.canonical_name: Institutional Response Fabric + Constitutional Cognitive Mesh

opportunity_registry.purpose: Tracks grants, tenders, publishing calls, income opportunities, courses, partnerships, research calls, content opportunities and investor pathways.

capability_registry.purpose: Tracks what T4H, WorkFamilyAI, MAAT, Factors, Integrity Stack and portfolio entities can credibly do, sell, teach, research or deploy.

evidence_registry.purpose: Tracks proof, receipts, outcomes, telemetry, deployments, datasets, pilots, research, impact, screenshots and governance proof.

asset_registry.purpose: Tracks reusable PDFs, posters, datasets, diagrams, videos, screenshots, reports, forms, decks and websites.

narrative_blocks.purpose: Stores reusable language primitives for grants, books, courses, proposals, content, tenders and research.

pov_registry.purpose: Stores WorkFamilyAI executive cognition nodes as institutional POV lenses, not fictional personas.

wrapper_templates.purpose: Defines thin channel wrappers that render the same evidence/capability base into different output formats.

scoring_model.purpose: Scores fit, value, evidence strength, reuse value, delivery readiness, deadline risk and conversion probability.

output_registry.purpose: Tracks every generated artefact and final rendering.

evidence_gap_register.purpose: Tracks missing proof needed to promote claims to REAL.

receipt_ledger.purpose: Tracks build, post, submit, publish and validation receipts.

seed_capabilities.name: Carer Companion and Family Support Intelligence
ADHD Desert and Access Gap Intelligence

funding_theses: Cognitive Accessibility and AI Sweet Spots
Child, Family and Community Digital Safety

pov_lenses.core_question: Is this safe, fair and accountable?
Will the machine learn and compound?

evidence_rules.DEIDENTIFIED_REAL: Real data stripped of identifiers; usable where lawful and ethical.
evidence_rules.PARTIAL: Exists but incomplete; usable only with qualification.
evidence_rules.SYNTHETIC: Demo/interface/testing only; excluded from impact claims.
evidence_rules.HYBRID: Demo/training only unless real and synthetic components are separated.
evidence_rules.INFERRED: Planning and modelling only; not observed evidence.
evidence_rules.PRETEND: Claim only; do not use externally.
